title: Ten receipts, one question
spec: U01 · the five layers and the four families, read off a single question
intro: Pin Q9 and ask it in every one of the ten toggles, left to right. You are not comparing answers — nine of the ten say the same thing. You are comparing receipt shapes, and one of them stops saying the same thing.
foot: Do it for real: Copilot panel, preset Q9, toggle bar left to right · or python bench/run_campaign.py --questions Q9 --modes naive,budgeted,compressed,cached,jit,graph,okf,notes,isolated,routed

steps.title: Ask the same question ten times
narrative: Q9 is the aggregation preset: "Summarize member M-2001's authorization history: how many requests and what were the outcomes?" Its answer key wants five facts — 2, PA-1001, APPROVED, PA-1004, MANUAL_REVIEW.

One question, ten strategies, ten graded receipts. That grid is the whole module: every toggle on the bar is a module later in the course, and this is the first time you see them all standing next to each other.
steps.youDo: Pin Q9 in the standing-questions list and click through the toggle bar left to right — naive to routed, ten asks.
steps.claudeSays: Each ask re-assembles the context from scratch under a different strategy, then the same answer key grades whatever comes back.

steps.title: Five layers: the receipt's unit of account
narrative: Every receipt itemizes the same five lines — system, retrieved, tool results, history, user turn — and they always sum to the input total. That sum rule is your first sanity check on any token dashboard.

Put naive and notes side by side and the point lands without a single definition. Naive spends 1,612 of its 1,700 tokens in one layer. Notes spends 50 there, moves 58 into history, and finishes the job for 167.
steps.claudeSays: Both answers name PA-1001 APPROVED and PA-1004 MANUAL_REVIEW. The model did nothing different; the assembler did.

steps.title: Four families, ten toggles
narrative: Every one of the ten strategies is a member of one of four families. Write puts context outside the window and reads it back (notes). Select ships only the shortlist (budgeted, jit, graph, okf). Compress rewrites what ships into fewer tokens (compressed). Isolate hands the load to a sub-agent with its own window (isolated).

Diagnose by layer, then act by family. Q9's fat line is retrieved, so anything that attacks retrieved is a candidate — and four different families all have a way in. That is why the taxonomy argument is a waste of time: name the layer, and the shortlist writes itself.

before.title: THE MAP, WITH Q9's NUMBERS ATTACHED

steps.title: The two that do not fit
narrative: Two toggles are not strategy families at all, and mislabelling them is a real mistake. cached ships the same facts — 736 input tokens on Q9, more than four of the select arms — but re-orders them so the stable part sits at the front where a cache can read it. It is position economics, not token reduction.

routed is not a lever either; it chooses levers by question class. On Q9 the router classifies aggregation and dispatches to isolated — so routed's receipt is isolated's receipt, 1,796 tokens, the most expensive correct arm on this question. A router is only ever as good as the graded evidence behind it, and this one has a class it has not learned yet.

steps.title: The shape that changed most
narrative: Look for the receipt that does not merely shrink but re-plumbs. That is isolated: retrieved drops to 0 and 1,710 tokens appear under tool results, because a sub-agent read the domain in its own window and handed back a summary.

And it costs more than naive — 1,796 against 1,700, with double the output tokens, because the main call pays for the sub-agent's work plus its own turn. Isolation buys you a clean window and a bounded blast radius. On a one-shot lookup it buys you nothing and charges you for it.

steps.title: The one that changed the verdict
narrative: Nine receipts differ in shape. One differs in outcome. compressed comes back at 208 tokens — an 88% saving against the control — and the grader stamps it ✕ FAILED, because the abstract dropped PA-1004 and MANUAL_REVIEW and replaced them with "her history shows consistent approvals".
That is the law this course runs on: a saving that changes the answer is not a saving. Shape is interesting; the stamp is decisive. U07 takes this exact cell apart and fixes it.
